FighterRequest.description: One side of the matchup, as understood from the user's words.

entity.description: Normalized name of the fighter, e.g. "grizzly bear".
entity.title: Entity

count.description: How many of them fight on this side (1 to 10,000).
count.title: Count

variant.description: Which kind, e.g. "adult male" or "polar"; empty when not specified.
variant.title: Variant

size_reference.description:
Another entity this fighter is sized like ("horse-sized duck" -> "horse"). Only a name,
never a number: code computes the scale factor from both stat sheets' mass_kg.

raw.description: The user's own words for this fighter.

body_analog.description: Real fighter whose sourced stats are the base, e.g. "saltwater crocodile".
body_analog.title: Body Analog

size_analog.description: Real fighter it is scaled to, e.g. "African elephant"; code computes the scale factor.
size_analog.title: Size Analog

heads.description: Number of heads (2-9), only with the extra_heads ability and a quote that says so.

terrain.description: Where they fight; the arena when the user didn't say.

raw_text.description: The user's full request, word for word.

assumptions.description: Choices intake made for the user, e.g. "Assumed adult male grizzly".
assumptions.title: Assumptions

text.description: What they say; it may only contain numbers from the stat sheets or results.

win_prob.description: Share of fights won by side 0 and by side 1.

draw_prob.description: Share of fights that ended in a draw.

mean_survivors.description: Average number of fighters left standing on each side.

outcome.description: Most likely result; no_contest means the two sides cannot engage.

deciding_factor.description: The stat or circumstance that mattered most.

deciding_factor_explainer.description: Plain-language explanation of the deciding factor, written by a code template.

status.description: Where it is; fallback means a stand-in was used and the battle continues.

display_name.description: Name shown to users and used in narration (letters, digits, spaces, hyphens).

media_name.description:
Generic, brand-free name used in image and music prompts, e.g. "electric pickup truck"
(letters, digits, spaces, hyphens).

category.description: What kind of thing it is.
category.title: Category

body.description: How it fights: living, machine, or inert.

lore.description: Required when category is mythical, otherwise None.

schema_version.description: Version of this shape, for cached sheets.

sheet_hash.description: Hash of the stats, used in the cache key and the simulation seed.

confidence.description: How much we trust it; always low for estimates.

is_estimate.description: True when the value is not from a source (method category_default or assumption).

method.title: Method

high.description: Top of the plausible range used for uncertainty sampling (filled by code).
